sections.changelog:
Added

  • Separate color control for the plain magnifier icon in Appearance, so it no longer has to match the accent color.

Changed

  • Synonyms are now folded into the primary ranking pass, so a result that also matches a synonym of a query word rises to the top (and, in Strict mode, results missing that word drop out) instead of only being appended below the plain matches. The strictness floor still counts the original query words, so adding a synonym never raises the bar.

Fixed

  • The clear "×" no longer overlaps the collapsed magnifier on a results page in Icon display mode (it is hidden while the field is collapsed).
